name: Farstrider Lodge
summary: Hunters and travelers come to Farstrider Lodge in southeastern Loch Modan for training, supplies, and work in the wilds. Its high elven style sets it apart, though dwarves and humans live there too.

sections.title: An Elven Haven in the Mountains
sections.body: Farstrider Lodge has an unusual look among the stone buildings of Khaz Modan. Its design suggests high elven craft. Vyrin Swiftwind is the only known high elf who still lives there, among dwarves and humans. No one knows who founded the lodge or when it was built.

sections.title: A Waystation for the Wilds
sections.body: In the southeastern hills of Loch Modan, Farstrider Lodge offers a stopping place for hunters and travelers bound for the surrounding wilds. Hunter and pet trainers work there, alongside merchants and people seeking help with local wildlife.

faq.q: Why is there an elven lodge in Khaz Modan?
faq.answer: The lodge's design suggests high elven origins, and Vyrin Swiftwind is its only known high elven resident. No one knows who founded it, when it was built, or what its first purpose was.

faq.q: Are there still high elves living here?
faq.answer: Vyrin Swiftwind is the only high elf known to live at the lodge. Dwarves and humans live there as well, including mountaineers and huntsmen who maintain the lodge and trade with travelers.

faq.q: What services are available at Farstrider Lodge?
faq.answer: Farstrider Lodge has hunter and pet trainers, merchants, and local requests concerning Loch Modan's wilderness.

angles.text: As a hunter, you can find marksmanship and beast training at Farstrider Lodge, amid the game in Loch Modan's surrounding hills.
As a dwarf, you share the lodge with human residents and the high elf Vyrin Swiftwind.
